say:0:1620918001:1.text: Before long, a new gravestone will be raised here. The headmaster with the thick spectacles will live on in name, his life remembered in a few lines of text, smiling softly at those who come to pay their respects.
say:0:1620918001:1.source_cn: 在不久的未来，这里将新竖起一座墓碑。那个戴着厚镜片眼镜...

say:1:1620918002:1.text: Who will come here? Old friends, mourners who remember him, curious students, or visitors drawn by his fame?

say:2:1620918003:1.text: What will they talk about? The headmaster's past, his accomplishments, his humor... or perhaps the little anecdotes that made him human? You wouldn't know. With your memories gone, he's a name more than a person.

say:3:1620918004:1.text: The cycle of days and nights witnesses the passage of time. The open ground doesn't feel like death. Only stillness. Only the calm of an afternoon sleep.
say:3:1620918004:1.source_cn: 白日、黑夜，在这片空地上流逝而去。此处没有死亡的气息，...

say:5:1620918005:1.text: Leymar's approaches carried their share of controversy, but I still believe he was a capable headmaster worthy of respect.
say:5:1620918005:1.source_cn: 不可否认，雷蒙校长的行为存在些许争议。但这并不影响我对...

say:6:1620918006:1.text: And here, he will rest with the legends who came before.
say:6:1620918006:1.source_cn: 他将于此，与过往的英杰并肩沉睡。

say:7:1620918007:1.text: And I'll keep watching. Just as I have for everyone else.
say:7:1620918007:1.source_cn: 而我也将在此处继续见证。正如见证其他所有人一般。

say:9:1620918008:1.source_cn: 雷蒙校长……我会永远记得您。

say:10:1620918009:1.text: I'll keep our promise. Once your stone is raised, I'll come with flowers and a sea-salt caramel cake.
say:10:1620918009:1.source_cn: 我会记住我们的约定。等墓碑立起后，我就带着花和焦糖海盐...

say:13:1620918011:1.text: What about you, Merlin? Aren't you going to do something?
say:13:1620918011:1.source_cn: 你呢，梅林？不打算做什么吗？
say:13:1620918011:1.male: What about you, Merlin? Aren't you going to do something?
say:13:1620918011:1.female: What about you, Merlin? Aren't you going to do something?

say:14:1620918012:1.text: You may not remember; Leymar once taught you too. And he's one of the few professors who didn't see you as a thorn in their flesh.
say:14:1620918012:1.source_cn: 虽然你失忆了，但过去雷蒙也曾为你授课。并且，他是少数没...

say:15:1620918013:1.text: In certain ways, you two spoke the same language.

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 不会是在挖地的方面吧？

say:18:1620918015:1.text: Leymar was famous for finding excuses to skip faculty meetings. You've been absent for twenty years straight. So yes, you are quite a match for each other somehow.
say:18:1620918015:1.source_cn: 雷蒙校长经常找借口缺席校领导会议，而你则连续二十年缺勤...

choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 是尽职尽责、教育学生的方面！

say:19:1620918016:1.text: Still tossing the question back to me? See? Amnesia hardly changes what's inside.
say:19:1620918016:1.source_cn: 还是和从前一样，把问题抛还给我吗？由此可见，记忆的缺失...

say:20:1620918017:1.text: That ancient herbal tea recipe has reminded me of something.
say:20:1620918017:1.source_cn: 刚才那份古老的花草茶配方，让我想起了一件事。
say:20:1620918017:1.male: That ancient herbal tea recipe has reminded me of something.
say:20:1620918017:1.female: That ancient herbal tea recipe has reminded me of something.
